summary: All 13 A–F deploy repos' .architecturerc (and ArgoCDDeploy's architecture.yaml header) name gen-architecture --help from the aac-tools toolchain as the judgment layer's schema, and all are pushed: the ArgoCDDeploy canary (carrying P6, 65872b9) alone, then three batches of four, every AaC build, collector build and Argo CD roll green. sweep_ledger.md is open with all 48 deploy rows; the Ansible branch carries no commit.
